descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B06 · P0 · 已知

口述「furosemide 减到 20」后，tracker 那一行仍是「Furosemide 40」，剂量没更新

票：TFA-92597 ready for qa（R7） · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：dev

思路 / Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S07 「医院，live：查房前列表填好 tracker，然后一次床旁带一个暂停、一个改剂量、一次单次给药、一个祈使句的开始和一个继续，同一段文字存两次」 Hospital, live: pre-round list seeds the tracker, then one encounter with a hold, a dose change, a one-time dose, an imperative start and a continue, saved twice on the same text

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 The pre-round medication list and the encounter Medication Tracker are one set of rows: a row the pre-round Save Note writes shows in the Post-Round tracker and a change from Save & Extract shows on …（UAT TC-19；TFA-92597 What；TFA-92597 AC 3）
  • U4 'Continue / keep / stays on X' is not an event: no re-dating, no Held, no new row.（UAT TC-19 ER 1；TFA-92597 R4）
  • U6 'Let's start X' is a plan: it becomes a task, not a row.（UAT TC-19 ER 3；TFA-92597 R3）
  • U7 A dose change renames the row to the new dose and keeps its history (the old dose stays readable on the row).（UAT TC-19 ER 4；TFA-92597 R7）
  • U8 Hold/stop dates and reasons are the ones dictated and are kept on every later save; they are never changed to the save date.（UAT TC-19 ER 5；UAT TC-19 ER 10；TFA-92597 R6）
  • U11 'Gave one-time X' → a single-dose row shown as Given that expires; the standing order of the same drug is untouched.（UAT TC-19 ER 8；TFA-92597 R2）
  • U13 A repeat hold on a held drug changes nothing; a held or stopped row never resets to active unless a restart is dictated.（UAT TC-19 ER 9；TFA-92597 R5）
  • U18 The step mix (starts, holds, stops, dose changes, conditional orders, one-time doses) is dictated across two days and passes in both Hospital and Nursing Home.（UAT TC-19 Steps；UAT 3.3）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Fresh physician with the fixture Hospital patient (no medications); live models on the local stack

When Pre-Round: type the pre-round text and Save Note. Encounter: type the encounter text and Save & Extract, then Save & Extract again on the same text (the former S17), and reload. Look at Post-Round → meds, Post-Round → tasks, then the Pre-Round Medications panel

Then Pre-Round panel lists the four drugs. After both saves and the reload: exactly five rows, one each for apixaban, furosemide, magnesium, metoprolol and atorvastatin (no second Given row, no re-applied hold); apixaban is Held · today with a reason naming the procedure; the furosemide row's NAME carries 20 and its history keeps 40; …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs per checkpoint (case-insensitive page-wide substrings): drug names present, no metolazone row, no Started/Stopped tag, a task naming metolazone, no 'extraction failed'. What page-wide substrings cannot see is in spec.manual and in each checkpoint's rowChecks: exactly five rows, exactly one row per drug, the furosemide row NAME has 20 and not 40, no tag on the metopr …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U40；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S07 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-19.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 dev · 票 TFA-92597 ready for qa

口述「furosemide 减到 20」并 Save & Extract 后，tracker 那一行还是「Furosemide 40」，没改成新剂量。

After the physician dictates 'reduce furosemide to 20' and taps Save & Extract, the tracker row still reads 'Furosemide 40' instead of being renamed to the new dose.

依据：Allure 8c1de1c9. The result says 'known: TFA-92597 R7'. Ledger #40 U40: 'Fail (known)'. Dev report §4. mergeMedEventsIntoList does not rename the row. Q18 (does R7 cover Save & Extract; Tim's spec expects the old name) is recorded too. The hold, repeat hold and task parts pass.

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：AICHECK · AI 输出检查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。

  • (backend): (compare with res-cp2 (same date); oracle-same-as is not built) pass: backend res-cp3 medications[status=held].changeDate exists

Plan: unit U40 (#40, ready-for-qa, live AI (Save Note / Save & Extract / Ask AI)) — Medication tracker live, Hospital then Nursing Home. Same seed. S07 changes only the Hospital patient's tracker and S08 only the resident's, so the parts never read each other's chart. Runs together with TC-19/S08.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #40, U40; checked: yes): Fail (known) after re-judge — S07: dose change keeps the old row name ('Furosemide 40' after 'reduce to 20') — known TFA-92597 R7; tasks: 3 pending, no duplicates across two Save & Extracts (cp4 had failed only on the 'Encounter Complete' scope end → fixed, re-judged Pass). S08 hold / repeat hold pass. Perf: Save & Extract 30–60 s, Save Note ~40 s on dev
